/-!
# A displayed collar width from finite numerical data

Every width is a finite minimum of positive rational expressions.  In
particular no compactness or choice operation can make it arbitrarily
smaller than its geometric and finite-jet inputs.  The same width is used
for an entire indexed family once those inputs have been bounded.
-/

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

def prescribedEndpointWidth (n : ℕ) (span ρ κ M Mslope m : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min (1 / 2) (min (span / 4) (min (ρ / 2)
    (min (κ / (4 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1)))
      (m / (8 * (Mslope + 1))))))

theorem prescribedEndpointWidth_margins
    (n : ℕ) {span ρ κ M Mslope m : ℝ}
    (hspan : 0 < span) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hMslope : 0 ≤ Mslope) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let δ := prescribedEndpointWidth n span ρ κ M Mslope m;
    0 < δ ∧ δ < ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧ 2 * δ < span ∧
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ κ / 2 ∧
      2 * Mslope * δ ≤ m / 2 := by
  let N : ℝ := ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hN : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
  have hden : 0 < 4 * N * (M + 1) := by positivity
  have hmassden : 0 < 8 * (Mslope + 1) := by positivity
  let δ := prescribedEndpointWidth n span ρ κ M Mslope m
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp only [δ, prescribedEndpointWidth]
    exact lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (by positivity)
      (lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (div_pos hκ hden) (div_pos hm hmassden))))
  have hhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hspanle : δ ≤ span / 4 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρle : δ ≤ ρ / 2 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hκle : δ ≤ κ / (4 * N * (M + 1)) :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hmle : δ ≤ m / (8 * (Mslope + 1)) :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have hκprod : δ * (4 * N * (M + 1)) ≤ κ := (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp hκle
  have hmprod : δ * (8 * (Mslope + 1)) ≤ m := (le_div_iff₀ hmassden).mp hmle
  have hNM : N * M * δ ≤ N * (M + 1) * δ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : M ≤ M + 1) hN.le) hδ.le
  have hMδ : Mslope * δ ≤ (Mslope + 1) * δ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : Mslope ≤ Mslope + 1) hδ.le
  change 0 < δ ∧ δ < ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧ 2 * δ < span ∧
    N * M * δ ≤ κ / 2 ∧ 2 * Mslope * δ ≤ m / 2
  refine ⟨hδ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith only [hρle, hρ]
  · linarith only [hhalf]
  · linarith only [hspanle, hspan]
  · nlinarith only [hκprod, hNM, hκ]
  · nlinarith only [hmprod, hMδ, hm]

theorem positiveReferenceMiddleMass_le_width

    have hR := positiveEndpointCutoff_nonneg r δ x
    have hsum := positiveEndpointCutoff_add_le_one hδ hgap.le x
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x -
        positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x := by linarith
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    linarith
  have hn := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := l) (b := r) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun x => 1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x - positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x)
    (fun x _ => hb x)

    simpa only [positiveReferenceMiddleMass, Real.norm_eq_abs,

/-!
# An actual radial fiber from two endpoint jet families

The two endpoint values are their physical radii.  The positive first
normal jets and bounded finite normal jets choose displayed collar widths
before the family index.  The integral construction supplies a genuine
positive radial derivative everywhere and matches the identity between
the two exits as a joint germ.  No determinant condition is needed at the
physical endpoints, so they may be turning radii.

def endpointFiberWidths (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) (side : Bool) : ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  prescribedEndpointWidth n (b - a) 1 κ M
    (max (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) 1) (b - a)

def endpointFiberLower (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
  min (prescribedPositiveCollarLower l c (η false) (c - l) κ 1)
    (min 1 (prescribedPositiveCollarLower d r (η true) (r - d) κ 1))

def endpointFiberCollar (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (side : Bool) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n a b (η side) a (b - a) side
    (A side) Prod.fst

def endpointFiberInterpolation (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d (endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η A) Prod.fst

private theorem morseRealization_AB {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (n : ℕ) :
    4 * Statements.morseChainB T n < Statements.morseChainA T n ∧
      0 < Statements.morseChainB T n := by
  apply morseChainParameters_pos
  rw [G.d_exact]
  exact_mod_cast morseChainInteger_ge_two n

/-- The retained turning point, IVP speed and both cuts belong to the
same radius entries used in the reference data. -/
theorem morseChain_retainedGeometry {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) : Statements.MorseChainRetainedGeometry T := by
  intro side n hn
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  let n := T.index + k
  let A := Statements.morseChainA T n
  let B := Statements.morseChainB T n
  let X := morseRightTurn A B
  have hAB := morseRealization_AB G n
  have hA : 0 < A := (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) hAB.2).trans hAB.1
  have hL : T.leftX side n = -log (3 / 2) := G.leftX_eq side k
  have hU : T.rightX side n = X + (1 / 100 : ℝ) / A ^ 4 := G.rightX_eq side k
  have hLT : T.leftX side n < X := by
    rw [G.leftX_eq]
    exact morseCellLeftCut_lt_rightTurn hAB.2 hAB.1
  have hUT : X < T.rightX side n := by
    rw [hU]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (div_pos (by norm_num) (pow_pos hA _))
  refine ⟨hAB.2, hAB.1, hL, hLT, hUT, hU, ?_⟩
  change deriv (T.radius side n) X = (1 / 100 : ℝ) * A ^ 5 * T.radius side n X
  rw [G.radius_speed, G.radius_eq]
  change G.factor side k * deriv (G.normal k) X =
    (1 / 100 : ℝ) * A ^ 5 * (G.factor side k * G.normal k X)
  rw [(G.model k).speed_at_root, (G.model k).radius_at_root, mul_one]
  ring

private theorem morseRealization_cell_mono {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    StrictMonoOn (T.radius side (T.index + k))
      (Icc (T.leftX side (T.index + k)) (T.rightX side (T.index + k))) :=
  morseCell_strictMonoOn (G.actual_radius_equation side k).1
    (fun x hx => ((G.actual_radius_equation side k).2.2 x hx).1)

private theorem morseRealization_radius_mem {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) {X : ℝ}
    (hx : X ∈ Icc (T.leftX side (T.index + k)) (T.rightX side (T.index + k))) :
    T.radius side (T.index + k) X ∈
      Icc (morseChainCellLeftRadius T side k) (morseChainCellRightRadius T side k) := by
  have hmono := (morseRealization_cell_mono G side k).monotoneOn
  have h := (G.actual_radius_equation side k).2.1.le
  exact ⟨hmono (left_mem_Icc.mpr h) hx hx.1, hmono hx (right_mem_Icc.mpr h) hx.2⟩

/-- The assembled height is literally the scaled radius speed at every
retained coordinate, including the two closed endpoints. -/
theorem morseChainGluedProfile_at_radius {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ n, 1 ≤ σ n ∧ σ n ≤ 2)
    (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) {X : ℝ}
    (hx : X ∈ Icc (T.leftX side (T.index + k)) (T.rightX side (T.index + k))) :
    morseChainGluedProfile G σ hσ (T.radius side (T.index + k) X) =
      Statements.morseChainAmplitude T σ (T.index + k) * deriv (T.radius side (T.index + k)) X :=
  (morseChainGluedProfile_model_germ G σ hσ side k (morseRealization_radius_mem G side k hx)).eq_of_nhds.trans
    (morseChainPhysicalModelHeight_apply_retained G
      (morseChainAmplitude_pos T σ hσ (T.index + k)) side k hx)

private theorem morseRealization_cell_inside {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ n, 1 ≤ σ n ∧ σ n ≤ 2)
    (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    Icc (morseChainCellLeftRadius T side k) (morseChainCellRightRadius T side k) ⊆ Ioo 1 G.rightEnd := by
  let D := morseChainSelectedProfileData G σ hσ
  intro x hx
  have hl : 1 < D.leftCut := D.cuts_inside.1
  have hr : D.rightCut < G.rightEnd := D.cuts_inside.2
  have hmid : D.leftCut < D.rightCut := D.order
  cases side
  · have h : -x ∈ Icc (D.left.enter k) (D.left.leave k) :=
      ⟨neg_le_neg hx.2, neg_le_neg hx.1⟩
    have h₁ : -x < -1 := h.2.trans_lt ((D.left.order k).2.trans (D.left.enter_lt_endpoint (k + 1)))
    have h₂ : D.left.enter 0 ≤ -x :=
      (D.left.enter_strictMono.monotone (Nat.zero_le k)).trans h.1
    exact ⟨by linarith only [h₁], (show x ≤ D.leftCut by
      change x ≤ -(D.left.enter 0)
      linarith only [h₂]).trans_lt (hmid.trans hr)⟩
  · have h : x ∈ Icc (D.right.enter k) (D.right.leave k) := hx
    have h₁ : D.rightCut ≤ x :=
      (D.right.enter_strictMono.monotone (Nat.zero_le k)).trans h.1
    exact ⟨(hl.trans hmid).trans_le h₁,
      h.2.trans_lt ((D.right.order k).2.trans (D.right.enter_lt_endpoint (k + 1)))⟩

private theorem morseRealization_join_inside {T : Statements.MorseChainData}
    (G : MorseChainGeometryWitness T) (σ : ℕ → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ n, 1 ≤ σ n ∧ σ n ≤ 2)
    (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    Icc (T.joinLeft side (T.index + k)) (T.joinRight side (T.index + k)) ⊆ Ioo 1 G.rightEnd := by
  have hL (s : Bool) (i : ℕ) : morseChainCellLeftRadius T s i ∈ Ioo 1 G.rightEnd :=
    morseRealization_cell_inside G σ hσ s i
      (left_mem_Icc.mpr (morseChainCellLeftRadius_lt_right G s i).le)
  exact morseCellLeftCut_lt_shortLeftCapCut.trans
    (morseShortLeftCapCut_lt_leftTurn hg.1 hg.2.1)

/-- A whole retained model interval lies in its own physical seam block. -/
theorem morseRealization_model_subset_block
    {T : MorseChainData} {σ : ℕ → ℝ} {D : ReferenceData} {C : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hreal : MorseChainRealization T σ D C) (side : Bool) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : T.index ≤ n) :
    T.radius side n '' Icc (T.leftX side n) (T.rightX side n) ⊆
      morseChainBlock T side n := by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hr
  have hab := (hreal.2.2.1 side n hn).2.1
  have hmono := (hreal.radius_strictMonoOn side n hn).monotoneOn
  have hlow := hmono (left_mem_Icc.mpr hab.le) hx hx.1
  have hhigh := hmono hx (right_mem_Icc.mpr hab.le) hx.2
  have hj := hreal.join_data side n hn
  have hjoin := hj.1
  rw [hj.2.1, hj.2.2.1] at hjoin
  cases side with
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hjoin
    change T.radius false n x ∈
      uIcc (T.radius false n (T.rightX false n))
        (T.radius false (n + 1) (T.rightX false (n + 1)))
    rw [uIcc_of_ge ((hjoin.le.trans hlow).trans hhigh)]
    exact ⟨hjoin.le.trans hlow, hhigh⟩
  | true =>
    simp only [↓reduceIte] at hjoin
    change T.radius true n x ∈
      uIcc (T.radius true n (T.leftX true n))
        (T.radius true (n + 1) (T.leftX true (n + 1)))
    rw [uIcc_of_le ((hlow.trans hhigh).trans hjoin.le)]
    exact ⟨hlow, hhigh.trans hjoin.le⟩

def morseTailIndex (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Equiv.boolProdNatEquivNat (side, k) + 1

def morseTwoTailAt {F : Type*} (middle : F) (tail : Bool → ℕ → F) : ℕ → F
  | 0 => middle
  | k + 1 => tail (Equiv.boolProdNatEquivNat.symm k).1 (Equiv.boolProdNatEquivNat.symm k).2

@[simp]
theorem morseTwoTailAt_middle {F : Type*} (middle : F) (tail : Bool → ℕ → F) :
    morseTwoTailAt middle tail 0 = middle := rfl

@[simp]
theorem morseTwoTailAt_tail {F : Type*} (middle : F) (tail : Bool → ℕ → F) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    morseTwoTailAt middle tail (morseTailIndex side k) = tail side k := by
  simp [morseTailIndex, morseTwoTailAt]

private theorem morseTwoTail_support_subset (middle : ℝ) (tail : Bool → ℕ → ℝ) :
    Function.support (morseTwoTailAt middle tail) ⊆
      ({0} : Set ℕ) ∪ ((morseTailIndex false) '' Function.support (tail false) ∪
        (morseTailIndex true) '' Function.support (tail true)) := by
  intro n hn
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Or.inl (by simp)
  | succ n =>

/-- One representation of a negative component, by its actual endpoint pair. -/
def N01aNegativeComponent (D : ReferenceData) : Type :=
  {p : ℝ × ℝ // NegativeRadialComponent D p.1 p.2}

namespace N01aNegativeComponent

variable {D : ReferenceData}

def left (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : ℝ := J.val.1

def right (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : ℝ := J.val.2

def interval (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : Set ℝ := Ioo J.left J.right

theorem property (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) :
    NegativeRadialComponent D J.left J.right := J.prop

theorem left_mem_core (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : J.left ∈ radialCore D :=
  ⟨J.property.1, J.property.2.1.trans J.property.2.2.1⟩

theorem right_mem_core (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : J.right ∈ radialCore D :=
  ⟨J.property.1.trans J.property.2.1, J.property.2.2.1⟩

theorem left_lt_right (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : J.left < J.right :=
  J.property.2.1

theorem left_zero (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : deriv D.w J.left = 0 :=
  J.property.2.2.2.1

theorem right_zero (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) : deriv D.w J.right = 0 :=
  J.property.2.2.2.2.1

theorem negative (J : N01aNegativeComponent D) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ J.interval) :
    deriv D.w r < 0 := J.property.2.2.2.2.2 r hr
